name: Clipboard history
summary: Remembers text you copy so you can find it again. Secrets are masked; stored text is encrypted.
description: Remembers text you copy so you can find and copy it again (type: clip). Secrets are masked before anything is stored; stored text is encrypted. Nothing is recorded while Lookout is paused or when a password manager asks not to be recorded.
approval_note: Records text you copy into an encrypted history. Secret detection is best effort.
